impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        for (very_long_index_name_for_the_lane_record, very_long_record_name_for_the_lane_xx) in
            (0..).zip(core::iter::repeat(()))
        {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
